candidates.subject: Yuvraj Singh
candidates.selection: ICC and BCCI document the 2007 six sixes, 2011 World Cup role, treatment and 2012 return. A distinct unused cricket comeback story, not a claim of measured audience demand.
candidates.working_title: Yuvraj Singh: The Comeback Beyond the World Cup
candidates.opening_hook: Six balls could make him famous. Returning to the field would ask something very different of Yuvraj Singh.
candidates.central_dramatic_question: How did Yuvraj Singh rebuild his international cricket career after cancer treatment?

reference_stages.equipment: Unbranded blue cricket kit, helmet, gloves and bat; left-handed batting

reference_stages.appearance: Recognisable 2011 adult identity; source-reviewed hair and face
reference_stages.equipment: Unbranded cricket kit and left-handed batting equipment

reference_stages.appearance: Recognisable post-treatment identity; source-reviewed hair, no invented medical scene
reference_stages.equipment: Unbranded cricket kit, left-handed batting and left-arm bowling

direction_requirements.identity_lock: Approve and hash-lock era-specific reference before character scenes.
direction_requirements.anatomy_gate: Left-handed batting and left-arm bowling; correct grip, crease, stumps and pitch geometry.
direction_requirements.animation_system: Cricket ball trajectories, field geometry and sourced milestones; transparent overlays must not cover the subject.
direction_requirements.packaging: Story-specific title and thumbnail; reject earlier channel headlines.

factual_guardrails: Verify all statistics, dates and milestones in a linked claim ledger before scripting.
Do not invent medical prognosis, private dialogue, motives or treatment scenes.
The 2011 World Cup preceded treatment and the 2012 return; do not reverse that chronology.
Label original CGI reconstructions and do not clone the athlete voice.
